# Yardlet 0.11.5
## New
- The built-in browser plays H.264 video and AAC audio, so MP4 video on sites such as X and LinkedIn plays as it does in Chrome. - Find and pick any saved password or code from the browser panel. Settings › Passwords and the key button's list search by name, username or site, and the key button shows on every site while the vault holds an item. - Two-factor codes: one-time code fields are found in more languages and sign-in steps. A code saved without a site is linked to its account's sign-in when nothing else could be meant, and the rest are listed in Settings › Passwords with a suggested site. - A blank browser tab shows a start page with the pages the task's tabs showed, as Safari, Chrome and the Codex app do, and the side panel's launcher offers them too. - Memory saver has Chrome's Moderate, Balanced and Maximum levels. A tab an agent opened that no panel showed is let go ten minutes after the agent's turn. - A Codex account's banked usage-limit resets show beside its limits and on its limit card, and one is used only after you confirm. - Before removing a saved Claude account, move its tasks to another folder of the same account. - A task started from another task nests under it in the sidebar, up to two levels. - Dots: send files and photos, see what a dot is working on, and answer its approvals, forms and option questions in Yardlet. Dot avatars animate, and moving between personal agents and tasks is quicker. - An agent can quote you by a phrase, and the message that holds it is passed on as you typed it.
## Fixes
- Long conversations and streaming Codex answers take much less work on the main thread, so scrolling and typing stay smooth with long histories, many saved cards and running subagents. - A Codex turn that failed on a busy server can be retried. - A Codex turn folds its work only once a final answer begins, as the Codex app does. - Agents get clearer failures from Yardlet's tools and the browser tools, with whether calling again can help.
## Install
Download `Yardlet-0.11.5.dmg` below, or `brew install --cask zzunkie/tap/yardlet`. Earlier versions update themselves. Requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon.

# Yardlet 0.11.4
## Security
- Values the password manager fills are kept away from agents in more places.
## New
- Personal agents, below Scheduled tasks in the sidebar, opens your Dots conversation. Scroll up to read earlier messages, and open its details panel for activity, schedules, computers and attachments. - At a new password field, Yardlet suggests a strong password, as Chrome and Safari do. It is saved right away, beside any password the item already has, and agents can make one when they sign up for an account. - Gmail drafts and sends can attach files from your Mac, and a draft can be deleted. - Forty more remote MCP services in the connector directory. - An agent's reply can link to the tasks it mentions.
## Fixes
- A turn's error card shows where the turn ended, and offers Retry only when retrying can help. - A folded turn keeps its calls in one summary line, and a Codex reasoning summary folds like Claude Code's thinking. - Reconnect signs in again when a server that listed its tools without a sign-in refuses a call. - A task's terminal reads a wrapped line as one line, and a program still running in it keeps the task shown as working.
## Install
Download `Yardlet-0.11.4.dmg` below, or `brew install --cask zzunkie/tap/yardlet`. Earlier versions update themselves. Requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon.

# Yardlet 0.11.3
## Security
- Agent tools are more limited in what they can reach: scheduled tasks an agent writes, which calls may use a task's tools, filled passwords and uploads. - Phone pairing and linking are hardened. The first phone protocol is no longer supported, so pair again with the current app. - The phone relay limits connections a Mac has not answered.
## New
- Choose the app's language in Settings › General: System, English or 한국어. - Keep tasks working with the lid closed, when you turn it on in Settings › General. - ⌘K finds tasks as well as commands. - Back and Forward (⌘[ and ⌘], or the mouse's back and forward buttons) go through what the window showed. Over a browser page, the mouse buttons go through that page's history. - With one tab, ⌃Tab and ⌃⇧Tab go to the next and previous task. - A button's tooltip shows its menu bar key. - The browser's address field suggests pages and searches as you type. - A call's images show on its line, and whole when the line is opened. - A two-factor code saved without a site is offered on the site its name names. - Agent CLIs installed with nvm, Volta, bun, npm or pnpm are found when Yardlet opens from the Dock. - Double-click the sidebar's line to return it to its standard width.
## Fixes
- An agent CLI that exits on its own no longer keeps two CPU cores busy. - A streaming Codex answer no longer redraws its whole turn, and scrolling the sidebar to its top no longer redraws the window. - Button tooltips show again after a scroll. - A task's terminal keeps running when the task leaves the screen. - Codex's running turn no longer clears right after you send. - A long tool call's progress no longer arrives after its reply.
Thanks to @minsujang0 for the detailed reports behind several of these changes.
## Install
Download `Yardlet-0.11.3.dmg` below, or `brew install --cask zzunkie/tap/yardlet`. Earlier versions update themselves. Requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon.
